title: Stairway to Nowhere
description: A surreal psychedelic scene depicts a grand ornate staircase and archway floating in a black void above a desert floor. A red figure stands at the bottom casting a long shadow, surrounded by floating platforms holding a red McDonald's car, an orange vintage truck with flowers, a burning van, and dripping rainbow liquid above.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal psychedelic illustration with a large ornate art nouveau archway and spiral staircase floating in a black void. At the bottom a solid red human figure stands on desert sand next to a black puddle with chairs, casting a long shadow. Floating platforms hold a red McDonald's car, an orange pickup truck with white flowers, and a burning van with flames. Rainbow red green and orange liquid drips from the top. Black background, bold outlines, vibrant contrasting colors.
